title: ARSENAL PLAYER CAPTAINED HIMSELF IN FPL. NOW ARTETA HAS BANNED IT!
description:
Fantasy football just became a team news problem at Arsenal.

Christos Tzolis picked himself in Fantasy Premier League. Then he made himself captain, before the Liverpool game. That hinted he would start.

A week later, he moved himself, Ezri Konsa and Riccardo Calafiori out of his team. Captain one week, dropped the next.

Arteta has now banned Arsenal players from picking themselves. He says the leaks must stop, because confidentiality is what builds trust. It is not just Arsenal, either. Chelsea warned staff too, after people moved one of their players out of fantasy teams.

First rule of voting: not for yourself.

Harmless fun or a proper leak? Which side are you on?
